subject.title: fix(xai): respect ssrfPolicy and request.allowPrivateNetwork in image_generate

question: Should xAI image generation inherit private-network authorization from both `browser.ssrfPolicy` and the full sanitized `models.providers.xai.request` transport policy through `useConfiguredRequest`?
rationale: The patch is mechanically consistent with the shared provider path, but it expands which existing operator settings can authorize or alter xAI image HTTP requests; repository policy requires owner judgment for this security and compatibility boundary.

options.title: Approve canonical shared scope
options.body: Keep `useConfiguredRequest`, accept both explicit opt-ins and the associated sanitized request overrides, then require current-head guarded-request proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow authorization scope
options.body: Revise the contract so only specifically approved private-network settings affect xAI images, with focused compatibility tests for excluded overrides.

options.title: Keep fail-closed behavior
options.body: Pause the change until maintainers define a provider-wide private-network authorization policy that applies consistently across image providers.

recommendation.title: Approve canonical shared scope
recommendation.body: Keep `useConfiguredRequest`, accept both explicit opt-ins and the associated sanitized request overrides, then require current-head guarded-request proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this person to both current provider image routing and repository SSRF boundary decisions.
